text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Weeeell now, City-san? No napping 
allowed, okay? Please wake uuuup, won't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, who are you even supposed to be? 
Sensei doesn't wear sunglasses. And that 
personality is completely off. Way too 
goofy. Do it properly, will ya?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Merciless! Aren't you being way too hard 
on me?! City-tan, give me a little more 
credit, will ya~?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Gross. ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, isn't that "City the Model"?

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You're right, she's soooo pretty in 
person... Oh no, what should we do? Should 
we talk to her? If we take a picture and 
post it to UmaStagram, it'd totally blow 
up, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ......City, you be Sensei too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whoa—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, double Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we can't see her face anymore. ...Oh 
well, she's with a friend... It'd be rude 
to interrupt. Let's go~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Let's act cool and play the part all 
day today. We finally got our matching 
look, so why not?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Sheesh. ...Fine, then I'll look 
totally stunning. 
I'll show you how a pro poses. Make sure 
you get the timing right, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"City's getting serious! Alright, let's 
play our hearts out from day one~!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"—Haaah~, I laughed soooo much. 
Summer Walk is the best! I wish vacation 
lasted forever."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Forever's a lie. You rest with everything 
you've got so you can train hard again... 
You know this long break is for that, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Ughhh... But tomorrow! It's Jordan's 
Presents Day! 
I came up with the absolute best plan 
ever. Get hyped, 'kay?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm worried. Whenever Jordan gets too 
hyped, 
nothing good ever happens."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pien. (🥺)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Whatever. 
...I'm looking forward to it, anyway. Make 
sure you hype me up, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Nice, totally sunny! City, c'mere~ 
...Alright, sunshine girl~♪ 
Day two's looking supes good? Nice."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Good omen, huh. But seriously, it's 
scorching... Is it midsummer or what? 
Isn't it worse than yesterday? The sun's 
so strong I can't even take my jacket 
off..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Then we've just gotta cool off with food! 
Look over there, that ice cream shop is 
mega-popular on Umastagram!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that's awesome... wait, that line is 
insane. ...Wait, is that? ...For real? 
For reaaal?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... hits the spot... Did we really wait 
like an hour in the end? 
Still... mm, it's actually really good. 
It's not just for looks."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Right?! It's practically pure fruit, so 
tasty♪ 
Guess we're in an era where just looking 
good doesn't cut it anymore. Not that I'd 
know, though."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"We've got tons of crazy delicious stuff 
lined up after this too. It's cheat week, 
after all. 
But we'll burn it off with a crazy amount 
of walking, so bear with me~."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, so I should be prepared for a 
jam-packed schedule. 
Fine with me. Where to next? ...What is 
that? A bird? ...A penguin?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"—City, there's a huge shark! Scary! 
Let's take a pic~ ...Ah, now, right now!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, whoa...! Isn't the timing on this 
super tricky? 
...Haha, what are you even doing?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Don't I look super shark-like? If I post 
this on Umatok, it might totally blow up! 
...Ah, another one's coming! City, you do 
it too, look! Hoo~♪"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Ahhh... my legs are killing me... I 
haven't walked this much in forever. 
...So, how was it? Did you get to do 
everything you wanted?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Of course! It was the best day ever! 
Imma go grab us some drinks real quick. 
Gimme a sec~."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you wait—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"(Ahhh... seriously. She's sooo... pretty. 
How does she still look this gorgeous 
after walking around all day?)"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"She really is on another level. 
Ever since back then, she always has 
been—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"—Whoa, she's on next month's cover... 
Gold City's really blowing up lately. 
She's our age, right? ...Haaah, talk about 
a social divide... So jealous."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"(—A girl I'd only ever watched from afar 
just happened to end up in my class. 
At first, I just thought it'd be cool to 
be friends with a celebrity. But...)"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Crap, gotta hurry or I'll miss curfew 
again...! We went way too hard at karaoke! 
...Whoops, huh? That girl..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah...! Dammit, like this, I'll 
never... 
I'm going to make everyone acknowledge 
me... I will...—"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I... I want to run...! 
Haaah...! Aaaagh...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ngh, h-huh? 
Why... can't I..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"(Her helplessness, her exhaustion, her 
desperate struggling... 
It hit me so hard. It made my chest ache, 
but even more than that...)"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"—...So cool. 
You're insanely cool, Gold City...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"(...Ever since that day, she's been a 
friend I'm proud of. 
Pretty, strong, and cool.)"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm really, really glad... I came with 
her. 
I'm so excited for City Presents Day 
tomorrow...♪"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —Wait, WHAAAT!?!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean we're not going anywhere 
today!?
